subject: Avery Health advocate mini-doc — scheduling, run-of-show, and release
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@averyhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Avery Health advocate mini-doc — initial scheduling

Hi Lisa,

Thanks again for agreeing to have Dr. Patel appear in a short 3-4 minute mini-documentary for the Redwood website. The goal is a conversational on-camera piece focused on the integration between Avery Health and our inference platform — in particular the latency/cost wins you saw in production.

Quick asks to get us moving:
- Do you have two windows in the week of Sept 7 that work for on-site filming (roughly 2 hours blocked)?
- Will Avery provide a conference room with controlled lighting, or should we bring LED panels?
- Please let me know who will sign the release (legal or marketing). I can send our standard advocate release to review.

Ive attached a short draft run-of-show and a sample release for review. If you prefer remote recording (Zoom + lav), we can do that as well — I included a remote kit checklist.

Thanks — excited to work with you on this.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Customer Advocacy Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Ben,

Thanks — this looks great. Sept 9 morning and Sept 10 afternoon would both work for the team. We can do on-site; I will confirm a small conference room with blackout shades.

For sign-off: marketing has permission to sign standard advocate releases, so that should be fine, but we need legal to quick-review the wording. Can you send the release to marketing and c.c. our legal contact? I am looping in marketing but copying only to keep thread size small.

Looping in a quick checklist from production side:
- Camera: one 4K cine camera, A7S3 or equivalent.
- Audio: dual lav + boom backup.
- Lighting: 2x soft LED panels plus fill.
- B-roll: 20-30s of Dr. Patel walking the floor, product UI close-ups (bring HDMI capture).
- On-site time: arrive 60 mins prior for set-up, 90 mins for interview and cutaways.

Monica — can you confirm we have HDMI capture and the in-house associate available for b-roll? I can bring a small kit but prefer folks on your side to handle building access.

Sean
Production Lead, Redwood Customer Media

Hi Lisa and team,

Thanks for confirming dates. We heard Sept 9 morning is preferred. Please find an updated run-of-show attached (tight 75-minute window) and a cleaned-up release doc with two small language tweaks legal often asks about.

High-level run-of-show (summary):
- 08:15 — Crew arrival, set build, sound check
- 09:30 — Interview with Dr. Patel (approx 30 min)
- 10:00 — B-roll: walk-and-talk + UI captures (approx 30 min)
- 10:45 — Wrap and brief debrief

Please review the release especially section 3 where we ask for right to time-limited promotional use (we propose 3 years). If your legal asks for alternate phrasing we can accommodate.

Attachments: Avery_Advocate_Release_v1.pdf (updated), mini-doc-shotlist.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Marketing to confirm signatory and return signed release by Aug 21.
2) Confirm exact room and A/V contact for building access.
3) Let us know any compliance needs (e.g., HIPAA redaction steps) for the final edit.

Ben
